original_test_intent: Verify approved non-default Advanced USB values persist and Load Default restores the exact platform defaults without regression.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Operator changes selected fields, saves/reboots, verifies persistence, then performs authorized default restoration.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Selected values and restored defaults match the specification.

historical_reviews.v3: NEED_ENGINEER_DECISION; MANUAL ONLY because all/random coverage and global default scope are undefined.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: BIOS owner defines coverage/values/final state and performs interactive changes.

master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Full-field or sampled matrix, values/defaults, reboot and final deployed state.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Sampled coverage must be explicit and cannot be called all-field completion.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed field matrix and before/after firmware evidence; automation may assist inventory only.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No OS substitute for BIOS setting behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Load Default can alter boot/storage/management dependencies.

safety_boundaries: No global default until impact/recovery approved
no_automatic_retry: No repeated defaults or recovery without approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: BIOS owner resolves all/random and result.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 correctly leaves this as a real engineering decision rather than guessing coverage.
